Final evidence after merge. Gerrit change 1768 merged as 450e1b6096f with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments. Held-out oracle was RED on the four-cell `jobs.test` placement, GREEN after moving the unchanged lock to `jobs.lint`, and returned to RED when the matrix invocation was defect-seeded; 175 focused tests, lint, typecheck, and config-check passed.

Natural post-merge sample: successful Verify run 31786710110 used the new target-branch workflow. `Complexity-baseline lock` appeared exactly once, in lint, and completed in 5s. It appeared zero times in Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS pytest jobs. The pre-change measured steps were 55s + 56s + 55s + 45s = 211 runner-seconds per Verify; the post-change single step is 5s, so measured aggregate saving is 206 runner-seconds per Verify. Policy coverage and fail-closed behavior are unchanged; no job/runner/assertion was removed. As expected for a parallel lint policy step, this buys runner capacity rather than macOS critical-path wall clock.

Sibling/parity sweep: the workflow oracle requires exactly one invocation across the reusable workflow, so no duplicate cell remains; this commit-level policy has no OS/Python behavioral surface. Residual risk is the still-long default test suite, tracked by parent `inedible-subsimious-brahmancow`.
